C001.text:
select * into #ys61 from s61 where YEAR(ngay_ct) = YEAR(GETDATE())
select * INTO #y72 from m72 where id_dh IN (SELECT ID FROM #ys61) select * INTO #y63 from m63 where id_dh IN (SELECT ID FROM #ys61) select * INTO #y54 from m54 where id_dh IN (SELECT ID FROM #ys61)
select id_dh,isnull(sum(t_tt),0) tien_n into #yn from #y72 group by id_dh select id_dh,isnull(sum(t_tt),0) tien_c into #yc from #y63 group by id_dh select id_dh,isnull(sum(t_tt),0) tien_x into #yx from #y54 group by id_dh
select a.id,a.ma_ct,b.tien_n,c.tien_c,d.tien_x into #yd from #ys61 a left join #yn b on a.id =b.id_dh left join #yc c on a.id =c.id_dh left join #yx d on a.id =d.id_dh
Select ma_ct,isnull(sum(tien_n),0) tiền_nhập,isnull(sum(tien_c),0) tiền_chi_hộ,isnull(sum(tien_x),0) tiền_xuất, count(*) so_luong from #yd group by ma_ct
drop table #ys61,#y54,#y63,#y72,#yc,#yd,#yn,#yx
